component.name: Yutaka
component.summary: Track your accounts, expenses, budgets and loans

description.p: Yutaka helps you keep track of your personal finances. Record income and expenses, manage accounts and budgets, and follow loans and repayments.
Use Yutaka offline or connect your own self-hosted sync service to keep your records synchronized across devices.

ul.li: Organize transactions with categories and date filters
Manage planned purchases, subscriptions and notes
Export analytics as PDF, spreadsheet or text reports
